content.text: One flaky assertion around relative "business hours" fixed by freezing clock at 2026-03-08 01:30 America/New_York. All green — closing.
Escalation timer unit tests assume the process timezone is UTC, so failures appear for engineers in US/Pacific and Asia/Seoul. We need fixtures that pin zones explicitly.

Add shared fixtures covering timer start/stop across UTC, America/New_York, and Asia/Tokyo, including a DST spring-forward boundary for New York. Done when the escalation timer suite passes with TZ set to each of those values in CI matrix jobs.
